subject: English
question_text: Read the beginning of a story. Write ten new sentences
stimulus: to complete the story. 1×10=10 Giashuddin Azam Shah was the ruler of Bengal. He was a kind and just ruler. He was very much fond of archery. One day when he was ..................
guide_solution: Story writing Giashuddin Azam Shah was the ruler of Bengal. He was a kind and just ruler. He was very much fond of archery. One day when he was hunting deer in jungle. Aiming at fawn he shot but missed. The arrow by chance pierced a son of a widow. Hearing the news, the widow was very much shocked and disappointed. Because of the fact that the victim was her only child. So, she went to the Kazi to pray for justice . She complained against the Sultan. The Kazi was moved to pity hearing the shocking news. But he could not decide what to do. Because of the fact that the complaint was against the Sultan. If he did justice to the widow, the Sultan might be displeased. Again, if he did not do it, he would remain guilty to the widow and to almighty Allah. At last, he made up his mind to bring the Sultan for justice. The Sultan stood before the Kazi. The Kazi asked him whether the complaint was true. The Sultan happily accepted his guilt and compensated the widow. Being pleased, the widow went home. The Kazi thanked the Sultan for his justness.
